statement: A source-reported 1302 USB/IP emulator serves GET_STRING_ATTRIBUTE index 0, 1, and 3 and an echo-style GET for opcode 0x87 after SET; virtual C6 currently serves index 1 and structural errors otherwise, with unknown key50 failing. Additional string requests and SET/GET sequencing are plausible Steam gates; there is no source-backed proof Steam Stable 1792618285 actually requests index3 or an 0x87 reply. Capture before deciding a compat change.
